mechanism.claim: A sign transition in the completed natural-gas-minus-oil return impulse changes the energy-to-Bitcoin spillover regime rather than extending an existing score level. During elevated BTC variation, follow the new published gas-positive/oil-negative direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of current UNG return minus equal-weight USO/BNO return after opposite prior source-valid sign
mechanism.why_distinct: HVECSP trades an absolute z-score tail and failed train. HVECTR trades only raw spillover-score polarity transitions and uses no HVECSP event/control, z threshold, crypto direction, OI, funding, premium, options, fitted outcome, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: irregular actual cash-close energy-regime transitions are absent from Gross9

features.spillover_score: UNG log(close/open)-0.5*(USO log(close/open)+BNO log(close/open)), finite strict nonzero
features.previous: immediately prior source-valid common energy session
features.transition: current and previous spillover scores have strict opposite signs
features.availability: five minutes after frozen actual NYSE close, including early close

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements after Gross9

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: source, Gross9, train/test/eval/final; terminal first failure; no proxies, weighting, score, previous-session law, transition, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
